description: This file defines the AuthService class, which provides methods for authentication-related operations using the Supabase client, including sign-in, sign-up, sign-out, retrieving current user, fetching user roles, and building AppUser instances.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: Provides authentication functionalities, including sign-in, sign-up, sign-out, and user role management.

methods.name: signIn
methods.description: Authenticates a user using email and password.

methods.name: signUp
methods.description: Registers a new user with email, password, and optional role (defaults to 'patient').

methods.name: currentUser
methods.description: Returns the currently authenticated user, or null if none.

methods.name: currentRole
methods.description: Retrieves the role of the current user from user metadata or defaults to 'patient'.

methods.name: fetchRoleFromProfiles
methods.description: Fetches the user's role from the 'profiles' table in the database based on user ID.

methods.name: buildAppUser
methods.description: Builds an AppUser object, attempting to resolve the user's role from metadata and profiles table.
